name: Mohammad Zaki
tagline: Building cross-platform tools that devs love.
bio: KMP / Android engineer obsessed with DX and beautiful UIs. Creator of StudyAI and OneManage.

experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer
experiences.description: Led the decoupling of a monolithic codebase into feature-specific modules, enabling parallel development streams and improving build times for the core team.
highlights: Engineered a high-performance Card Scanning module for a major telecom application, utilizing optimized image processing to boost scanning success rates by 124% (from 33% to 74%).
Spearheaded the migration of the data layer from GSON to Kotlinx Serialization, achieving a 20% increase in parsing speed and significantly reducing memory overhead.
Optimized application startup time by profiling bottlenecks and integrating the Jetpack App Startup library, resulting in a seamless cold-start experience.
Recognized with a Certificate of Appreciation (Feb 2025) for exceptional delivery and innovation in core architecture optimization

experiences.title: Senior Android Developer
experiences.description: Developed and maintained several apps improving app sizes, crash rates and server million of users.
highlights: Orchestrated a comprehensive refactoring of the Instore app (2M+ downloads), utilizing R8/ProGuard optimization to reduce APK size by 75% (80MB to 20MB), driving higher install conversions.
Maintained product stability for millions of users by establishing quality gates, achieving a 99.9% crash-free rate via Firebase Crashlytics monitoring
Designed and implemented a serverless “Refer and Earn” reward system, leveraging local logic to eliminate backend costs while increasing user retention.
Revamped the UI/UX for the Collage Maker app (50k+ downloads), implementing dynamic layouts and custom views to improve user engagement
Mentored junior developers on Android best practices, code reviews, and architectural patterns (MVVM/Clean Architecture).

experiences.title: Software Engineer
experiences.description: Developed critical features for the Mr. Delivery and Logistech suites, including multi-merchant carts, payment gateway integrations (Stripe, HyperPay), and real-time driver tracking.
highlights: Awarded Employee of the Month for demonstrating ownership and delivering critical features ahead of schedule

philosophy.text: Performance is a Feature, not a polish step.
UI logic belongs in Domain-Driven states.
Build Scalable Architecture at start, will help in long run.
